'''Mos Espa Way''' was a major thoroughfare in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] that ran the length of the town and was devoted to the tourist trade. Tourist traffic was heavy and both the entertainment and merchant districts fronted the street. Over a dozen docking bays sat right on Mos Espa Way and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] and [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] both had town houses that were accessed from the street. [[W. Wald]] once added graffiti about [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] there.
